$comment: Hand-maintained OPTCG banlist overlay — THE authority for format-2 legality rows (build plan M4: community scrapers lag Bandai, so a human edits this file against the official page). cardId is the card number (card_identities.external_key, game_id 2). The applier (scripts/ingest/optcg-legalities.ts, run nightly by punk-records and manually via `pnpm ingest:optcg-legalities`) diffs entries against current DB rows: close what's gone, open what's new, source 'bandai:<effectiveFrom>'. Pair bans are symmetric card+card per Bandai's wording — keep BOTH mirrored entries when editing.
